BE JT ORDAINED B Y THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:

be amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 7- 0 in the area bounded by

       Oleander Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Belmont
       Avenue, and a line 68 feet east of and parallel to North Oleander
       Avenue,


to those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.



SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due pubUcation.
